ALL IN CAPITAL | INBOUND APPLICATION
Application Form Response
Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote them.
Company
Company name CAPilot (CAPilot Labs Pvt. Ltd.)
Website www.capilot.example
Location Ahmedabad, Gujarat
Incorporated December 2025
One-line description AI assistant for CA firms to reconcile GST data and draft notice replies.
Sector (as selected) Fintech
Stage (as selected) Pre-seed
Team size 6
Founders
Founder 1 Dhruv Shah, CEO. Qualified Chartered Accountant, 4 years in practice
handling GST for about 60 clients. linkedin.com/in/dhruv-shah-example
Founder 2 Isha Merchant, CTO. 3 years at a SaaS company. Built the matching
engine. linkedin.com/in/isha-merchant-example
Time commitment Both full-time since February 2026.
Prior startup experience None.
Equity split Founders 90%, one angel 10%.
Product and traction
What have you built? A web app where CA firms upload books and GST portal data. It
matches invoices, flags mismatches and drafts notice replies for the CA
to review.
Customers 24 paying CA firms, 7 on free trial. 2 firms have churned.
Revenue Monthly recurring revenue INR 78,000 (INR 9.4 L annualised).
Customer acquisition Mostly the founders' network and referrals from other CAs. We have
not measured acquisition cost yet.
Accuracy and liability Every drafted reply is reviewed by the CA before filing. Responsibility
sits with the CA.
Key risks Model errors on unusual notices and dependence on GST portal data
formats.

Fundraising
Amount raising INR 1.5 Cr
Valuation expectation INR 10 Cr post-money
Existing investors One angel, INR 15 L.
Use of funds Engineering and AI, sales, compliance and security.
Other investors in
conversation
None yet.
How did you hear about us? Public application form.
Anything else we should know?
We believe CA firms are underserved by existing tools. We would welcome a call.
